lines.differs: Worse for AtliQ than CareBridge Clinics Inc: Expands protected health information scope to cover subcontractor data and electronic records, widening AtliQ's compliance burden.
Worse for AtliQ than AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd: Imposes direct regulatory definitions and subcontractor oversight instead of an internal intercompany flow-down arrangement.
Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: Brightwater imposed a twenty-four-hour incident notification deadline and offshore processing ban, while this text only defines terms.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: Unilateral indemnity covering regulatory fines and notification costs, whereas PayTrack provided mutual indemnity limited to third-party claims.
Worse for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: Unilateral indemnity covering regulatory fines, notification costs, and subcontractor events, rather than mutual indemnity limited to third-party claims.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: Unilateral indemnity covering regulatory fines, penalties, and notification costs, whereas Sunrise Foods was mutual and restricted to third-party claims.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: Prohibits using data to train artificial intelligence models and grants no license rights, whereas Rohan granted a perpetual license.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: Expressly forbids using data for artificial intelligence model training, and client ownership is not conditioned on full payment.
Worse for AtliQ than CloudSpan Technologies: Expressly bans using data to train artificial intelligence models, without explicitly recognizing AtliQ's rights in pre-existing tools and know-how.
